I got the date from her own DM with me, which she can see herself. I couldn't check it against the private note I saved in gbrain. The brain refused to read it because this connection isn't tied to any member. Nothing was read or changed.

If you want the bot to be able to read that note back, an admin on the brain host would need to tie the connection to a member. The command gbrain suggested is:
gbrain auth rescope --token <this connection's token> --member '<MEMBER>'
For a shared bot like this one, it suggested listing the members the bot may act for with --may-act-for instead.
